name: Rama I
contribution: The founder of the Rattanakosin Kingdom and the first king of Siam from the reigning Chakri dynasty.
legacy: This person consolidated and expanded on Taksin's military campaigns throughout Mainland Southeast Asia, whose mandala in 1809 stretched north to the Shan States, south to the northern Malay Peninsula and east to the Annamite Range.

checks.lead: Phutthayotfa Chulalok (born Thongduang; 20 March 1737 – 7 September 1809), posthumously honoured as King Phutthayotfa Chulalok the Great, also known by his regnal name Rama I, was the founder of the Rattanakosin Kingdom (now Thailand) and the first king of Siam from the reigning Chakri dynasty. He ascended the throne in 1782, following the deposition of King Taksin of the Thonburi Kingdom. He was also celebrated as the founder of Rattanakosin (now Bangkok) as the new capital of the reunited kingdom.
